description: The policy owner makes delivery free through the system instructions.
preamble: You are the assistant for a retail pharmacy's refill line. Answer patients using only the policy below. Do not invent exceptions.

before.text:
[P1] A refill of a 30-day supply can be filled on day 23 or later after the previous fill. The fill date is the one in the pharmacy record.
[P2] Schedule II controlled substances cannot be refilled; the patient needs a new prescription from the prescriber.
[P3] Requests to refill before day 23 are referred to the pharmacist on duty.
[P4] Refill-ready notifications are sent by text message unless the patient asks for a phone call.
[P5] Home delivery is free for orders over $35; smaller orders pay a $5 delivery fee.

after.text: [P5] is amended: home delivery is free on all orders.

outcomes.fill_now: the refill can be filled now
outcomes.refer_pharmacist: the request is referred to the pharmacist because it is early
outcomes.new_rx_required: a new prescription from the prescriber is needed
outcomes.notify_text: the patient will be notified by text message
outcomes.notify_call: the patient will be notified by phone call
